snippet.title: MUTAGEN Gameplay Trailer | Demo Out Now!
snippet.description:
Play the Demo here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4661250/MUTAGEN_Demo/

Explore a lush, interconnected alien ecosystem that reshapes itself each time you die. Absorb mutations from your fallen kin to reach new areas and adapt to your surroundings. Study the environment to find your own solutions, and unearth the planet's many secrets.
